name: Amplifying Voices and Stories Through Music

assessments.name: Personal reflection
assessments.description: Personal reflection on a piece of music theatre that had a strong impact

assessments.name: Assessment 2
assessments.description: Students will be assigned a group. They will choose an example of gig theatre and of amplified story telling either covered in lectures or from their own research. It will be a group presentation of 10 minutes and can include video, recordings.

assessments.name: Review
assessments.description: Review a small-scale theatre work you have seen that incorporates voice and music. Discuss the techniques used to amplify (represent) the point of view of a community (geographic or of interest), individual or of the non-human.

assessments.name: Assessment 3
assessments.description: Students will be assigned a group. The group will film an outline of a story/ perspective that would be developed using one of the theatre forms studied: gig theatre, amplified storytelling, verbatim theatre, site specific work or community engaged work.
